QuestInfo.name: That's So Raven
QuestInfo.0: You managed to find your old treasure vault. Luckily, no one else made it in before you could.
QuestInfo.1: The treasure vault is locked up tight and you lost the key hundreds of years ago. It's not the most eloquent solution, but it's time to break the lock! You try to forget how much it cost before you shatter it to pieces. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You found the 'Memoirs of Raven: Ultimate Thief Master,' a collection of lessons from your teacher. He was a world-renowned scoundrel, but he sure was full of himself.\n\nRaven often warned you, "don't try to rob a kingdom with a box full of bobby pins." You never did understand what that meant.

0.0: My defenses were too powerful for common thieves! My locks are impervious to picking! One must have the key to... where is the key? I don't have the key.
0.1: Well, no matter. A master thief knows how to gain entry to anything, even his own extremely complicated locking mechanisms. I'll just hit it really hard with this stick!

yes.0: Ah, whatever! My 2nd Job Advancement is way more important than a silly old #o9001045#. It's not like I'm running low on money! I'll just buy a new one!

no.0: Now is this the vault where the #o9001047# comes out to vaporize any would-be trespassers if the #o9001045# gets broken?

1.0: That wasn't too much of a fuss. I suppose Raven wasn't just blowing smoke when he told me, 'Learn a skill once, and you'll forget it next Tuesday, but learn a skill twice and you'll master it for a lifetime.'
1.1: Ah, master Raven... if only you had listened to your own advice and learned how to disarm a bomb more than once. It was a sad day for us all...

yes.0: But, thanks to that crazy old coot, I am on my way to becoming the greatest thief in all of Maple World... again. I'm sure he would be proud, but he would also probably try to rob me, so I'm glad he's dead!
